title: Owl reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- owl body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='24' ry='27' fill='#b07a3c'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='15' ry='18' fill='#e8c98a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='21' fill='#b07a3c'/>
  <!-- ear tufts -->
  <polygon points='32,18 36,4 44,16' fill='#8a5a28'/>
  <polygon points='68,18 64,4 56,16' fill='#8a5a28'/>
  <!-- facial disc -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='17' ry='15' fill='#e8c98a'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='32' r='8' fill='#8a5a28'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='32' r='8' fill='#8a5a28'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='32' r='5.5' fill='#ffd94a'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='32' r='5.5' fill='#ffd94a'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='32' r='2.5' fill='#3a2a10'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='32' r='2.5' fill='#3a2a10'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='30.5' r='1' fill='#fff7d0'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='30.5' r='1' fill='#fff7d0'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <polygon points='46,42 54,42 50,50' fill='#ff9a2e'/>
  <!-- wings holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='62' rx='7' ry='14' fill='#8a5a28' transform='rotate(15 24 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='62' rx='7' ry='14' fill='#8a5a28' transform='rotate(-15 76 62)'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <polygon points='30,68 50,74 50,90 30,84' fill='#4fa3e0'/>
  <polygon points='70,68 50,74 50,90 70,84' fill='#3f8fd0'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='74' x2='50' y2='90' stroke='#2a6fa8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='34' y1='72' x2='46' y2='75' stroke='#bfe4ff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='34' y1='76' x2='46' y2='79' stroke='#bfe4ff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='34' y1='80' x2='46' y2='83' stroke='#bfe4ff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='87' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#ff9a2e'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='87' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#ff9a2e'/>
</svg>
